metricConfigs.description:
A map of metric codes to their configurations. If a configuration is not provided, the
[metric's default config](BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Meta#defaultConfig) will be used.

versionDiffMetricConfigs.description:
A map of version diff metric codes to their configurations. If a configuration isn't
provided, the [metric's default config](BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Meta#defaultConfig)
will be used.

files.description:
A list of glob patterns that will be checked against {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.FileSpec#filePkgPathUrl}.
If a file matches any of these patterns, these overrides will be applied.

title:
Optional overrides for {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Config}. These allow for more granular
configuration of code analysis' behavior, but should be used sparingly and only with
valid justification.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Config.Override
